Name: (CP) BB's New Livestock- Compsognathus
Author: Bibliobeast
Description:
[size=4][b]﻿Increase your animal diversity by adding Compsognathus (Compies) to your coop!

[/b][/size]After donating a piece of amber with a strange insect inclusion, Gunther presented you with an egg. When Marnie caught wind of your find she reached out to an old penpal at DewGen, a somewhat shady genetics research organization. You don't know how they did it, but they brought Compsognathus back to life, with a few... mutations? 

[size=4][b][u]Features[/u]
[/b][/size][list]
[*]Adds Compsognathus dinosaurs as a new animal to Marnie's shop! This is not a reskin of the dinosaur. 
[*]Compies will produce eggs every day that can be converted into mayonnaise (1 egg : 1 mayo), pickled (3 eggs : 1 pickled eggs), make a fried egg (FIXED!), sold, given to grateful villagers, or hatched using an incubator in the coop to hatch a Compy chick! 
[*]After 5 heart's of animal friendship, Compies will occasionally find more amber, presenting them to you as a gift
[*]Chicks will hatch after 5 in game days, and mature into adults after 4 days
[*]Mod comes in 2 play styles: Unlock Required and No Unlock
[*]Change the drop rates of important items (Spoilers)
[/list]
[u][size=3]Unlock Required (recommended)[/size][/u][spoiler]The intended way to play, amber-bound insect minerals (new item) will be dropped form magma geodes(you can change drop rates in the GMCM config menu). Once found, donate it to Gunther to receive a Compy egg as a reward. You'll also receive mail from Marnie the next day with instructions on how to unlock them in her shop (VERY easy!)[/spoiler] 

[u][size=3]No Unlock[/size]
[/u][spoiler]If you're not feeling the tediousness of finding amber in the wild, unlock them immediately in Marnie's shop by disabling the 'UnlockCondition' checkbox on the MCM config menu. Donation and rewards from the museum still possible![/spoiler]

 [u][size=4][b]Installation Notes[/b][/size]
[/u][b]I highly recommend[/b][b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23721]Extra Museum Space[/url]﻿ so you don't run out of room with the new mineral, and [/b][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar [/url]to add Compies to Marnie's shop smoothly and select specific skins. 
[/b]
﻿﻿This mod requires both [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ to work correctly! 
Download and install the latest SMAPI and Content Patcher
Download and unzip "[CP] BBs New Livestock-Compsognathus" ver 2.0 (now includes unlock conditions toggle)
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy!

[u]Note on Skins[/u]- If you do not have Livestock Bazaar, though I highly recommend it, you will have to set the skin that appears in Marnie's shop manually using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿, and choosing a default. If you do not have either Livestock Bazar or GMCM, you can still get different Compy skins, however it will be dependant on RNG, as the non-common skins have a lower probability of hatching from eggs (1/2 as likely).

 [b][size=3][u]Patch Notes

[/u][/size][/b][size=4]Ver 2.0- [u]IMPORTANT update[/u][/size]
[list]
[*]fixes the amber insect mineral spawn bug caused by including it in artifact spots. This item has been moved and will now drop from magma geodes. Geode drop rate toggle-able.[u] This should solve the problem where artifact spots were spawning no items when hoed. Please let me know if it persists.[/u]
[*]fixes the error with the fried Compy egg recipe, should now be functional
[*]No more 2 versions, added a toggle-able UnlockCondition to the GMCM menu. Default is enabled.
[/list]
[size=4]Ver 2.1 [/size]
[list]
[*]Fixes the insect amber drop from compies that have enough friendship points, should no longer appear as an error item
[/list]

[/list]
